summary: Full end-to-end test of No_Photo_PIX (FastAPI + React + MongoDB). All 6 backend pytest tests pass (config, photos list, admin login success/fail, upload auth check, full upload→list→serve→delete flow). Frontend UI verified: hero/title renders, 8 seeded photos load in gallery grid, heart toggle increments selection count, payment bar shows correct count (3) and total (9 €), PayPal button opens correct URL pattern, clear button resets, admin login rejects wrong password, accepts '97140', file upload succeeds (9 photos shown post-upload with UPLOAD badge), delete hover button visible. No critical issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin token is just the plain password ('97140') sent back as token — fine for this simple use case but should be a random session token if security is a real concern.
Upload endpoint accepts the title field from form but uses file.filename as fallback — OK.
No file size limit on upload — consider adding MAX_FILE_SIZE check to prevent abuse.
PayPal URL opens via window.open in new tab; PayPal's server redirects paypal.me/... → paypal.com/paypalme/... which is normal behavior.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 8 Unsplash photos on startup if photos collection is empty. Test created+deleted one TEST upload (cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All endpoints verified at https://image-select-pay.preview.emergentagent.com/api. Frontend at /admin uses password '97140'. data-testids: hero-title, photo-card-{id}, photo-heart-{id}, payment-bar, selection-count, total-price, paypal-pay-btn, clear-selection-btn, admin-login-form, admin-password-input, admin-login-btn, upload-input, upload-zone, admin-photo-{id}, delete-photo-{id}, admin-logout-btn. PayPal popup opens paypal.me/nophotopix/{total}EUR which PayPal then redirects to paypal.com/paypalme/...
